messages:
acme-integration: Hey, getting 400 from /v1/rerank for a bunch of requests since this morning. Example curl and body below, response just says 400 Bad Request. Anyone seen this pattern?

acme-integration: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"items":[{"id":"q1","query":"best coffee near me","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Coffee Shop","score":"0.92"},{"id":"c2","text":"Espresso","score":"0.85"}]}]}'
```

sara_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact response body (not just status) and the x-request-id header if present? Also which SDK/version or custom client are you using?

acme-integration: Response body is `{"error":"invalid_request","message":"Invalid candidate score type"}` and header `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`. We're using an internal Node fetch wrapper, not the official SDK. Scores are coming from our DB as strings.

prateek_engineer: ah, looks like scores are strings in the payload (`"score":"0.92"`) — the rerank API expects numeric scores if provided. Usually the server returns a 400 with that message. Can you share a trimmed raw body (no curl) so I can repro?

acme-integration: sure — raw body: ```json
{"items":[{"id":"q1","query":"best coffee near me","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Coffee Shop","score":"0.92"},{"id":"c2","text":"Espresso","score":"0.85"}]}]}
```

ingrid_oncall: Also confirm you're not double-stringifying the whole body (e.g., sending `"{\"items\":...}"`). That would appear as a string and could also trigger parse/type issues.

acme-integration: nope, we do `JSON.stringify(payload)` once. The only quirk is the DB stores score as varchar, so we inject it into the candidate object without casting.

prateek_engineer: repro'd locally with same shapes — server raises `Invalid candidate score type: expected number`. Quick fix: cast score to Number before sending or omit score field entirely (server will rank without client scores). Example corrected payload: ```json
{"items":[{"id":"q1","query":"best coffee near me","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Coffee Shop","score":0.92},{"id":"c2","text":"Espresso","score":0.85}]}]}
```

prateek_engineer: If you want a minimal failing vs passing curl: failing: `-d '{"items":[{"id":"q1","candidates":[{"id":"c1","score":"0.92"}]}]}'` -> 400. Passing: `-d '{"items":[{"id":"q1","candidates":[{"id":"c1","score":0.92}]}]}'` -> 200.

acme-integration: Awesome, that fixed it. We'll push a patch to cast DB values to numbers before payload construction. Any chance the API can give a clearer hint in the 400 body about expected types? The message was short.

sara_support: Good point — filing an internal ticket to improve the error message to include field path and expected type. For now we added a note in the rerank docs about numeric scores and common client pitfalls. Thanks for the quick repro and request-id (req_0a1b2c3d) — we'll tag it in the ticket. :white_check_mark:

acme-integration: thanks all!
